title: Constructing simple geometrical figures
summary: Plan and verify constructions using rulers, compasses, set squares and protractors.
objectives: Choose suitable instruments and data for a geometric construction.
Construct and verify angle bisectors, perpendicular bisectors and parallel lines.
Construct triangles from SSS, SAS or ASA data and check that the data determine the figure.

blocks.text: SSS uses three side lengths, SAS uses two sides and their included angle, and ASA uses two angles and the included side. Equal-radius arcs construct perpendicular bisectors and angle bisectors; copied corresponding angles construct parallel lines.

sections.title: Worked example

prompt.text: A 92° angle is bisected. Find either constructed angle.

sections.verification_note: The result follows the stated property and satisfies the original geometric conditions.

prompt.text: A perpendicular bisector crosses a 12 cm segment. How far is the crossing from an endpoint?

feedback.text: The crossing is the midpoint, 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm.

blocks.text: Name the relevant property, write the complete angle or construction relationship, calculate carefully, and check that every angle and length is geometrically possible.
